content: 1. Sodium malate is a food acid commonly used in food products. 2. Sodium metabisulfite serves as a preservative, antioxidant, and bleaching agent. 3. Sodium methyl para-hydroxybenzoate is utilized as a preservative. 4. Sodium nitrate functions as a preservative and color fixative. 5. Sodium nitrite is also used as a preservative and color fixative. 6. Sodium orthophenyl phenol acts as a preservative. 7. Sodium propionate is employed as a preservative. 8. Sodium propyl para-hydroxybenzoate is another preservative. 9. Sodium sorbate is used as a preservative. 10. Sodium stearoyl lactylate functions as an emulsifier. 11. Sodium succinates are used as acidity regulators and flavor enhancers. 12. Sodium salts of fatty acids serve as emulsifiers, stabilizers, and anti-caking agents. 13. Sodium sulfite is a mineral salt that acts as a preservative and antioxidant. 14. Sodium tartrates are food acids. 15. Sodium tetraborate is used as a preservative. 16. Sorbic acid is a preservative. 17. Sorbitan monolaurate functions as an emulsifier. 18. Sorbitan monooleate is also an emulsifier. 19. Sorbitan monopalmitate serves as an emulsifier. 20. Sorbitan monostearate is used as an emulsifier. 21. Sorbitan tristearate functions as an emulsifier. 22. Sorbitol acts as a humectant, emulsifier, and sweetener. 23. Soybean oil accounts for approximately half of the global production of edible oils. 24. Spearmint oil is frequently used for flavoring mouthwash and chewing gum, among other applications. 25. Star anise is a spice with various culinary and medicinal uses. 26. Star anise oil is a highly fragrant oil used in cooking, perfumery, soaps, toothpastes, mouthwashes, and skin creams. Notably, 90% of the global star anise crop is used in the production of Tamiflu, a medication for avian flu. 27. Starch sodium octenyl succinate is a thickener and vegetable gum. 28. Stearic acid is used as an anti-caking agent. 29. Stearyl tartrate functions as an emulsifier. 30. Succinic acid is a food acid. 31. Sucralose is an artificial sweetener. 32. Sucroglycerides are used as emulsifiers. 33. Sucrose acetate isobutyrate serves as an emulsifier and stabilizer. 34. Sucrose esters of fatty acids are used as emulsifiers. 35. Sulfur dioxide acts as a preservative and antioxidant. 36. Sulfuric acid is used as an acidity regulator. 37. Sunflower oil is a common cooking oil and is also used in the production of biodiesel. 38. Sunset Yellow FCF is a coloring agent that provides yellow and orange hues (FDA designation: FD&C Yellow 6). 39. Talc is used as an anti-caking agent. 40. Tannins serve as colorants, emulsifiers, stabilizers, and thickeners. 41. Tara gum is a thickener, vegetable gum, and stabilizer. 42. Tartaric acid esters of monoand diglycerides of fatty acids function as emulsifiers. 43. Tartrazine is a coloring agent that provides yellow and orange hues (FDA designation: FD&C Yellow 5). 44. Camellia oil, also known as tea oil, is widely used in southern China as a cooking oil. It is also utilized in the production of soaps, hair oils, and various other products.
